title: Schrijver Number Quasi-Tensorization and Multicolor Ramsey Bounds via Robust OR Polynomials
summary: We introduce a robust OR polynomial framework for composing positive semidefinite certificates across OR constraints. We demonstrate the power of this method in two applications. The first is on acute-free families. A set $\mathcal F=\{(x_i^{(1)},\ldots,x_i^{(r)})\}_{i=1}^M \subseteq (S^{n-1})^r$ is $r$-way acute-free if, for every $i\neq j$, there is a coordinate $t\in[r]$ such that $\langle x_i^{(t)},x_j^{(t)}\rangle\leq 0$. We write $M_r(n)$ for the maximum size of such a set, and $M_r^{\pm}(n)$ for the hypercube restriction. On the hypercube, $r$-way acute-free sets are independent sets…
